title: Heli-Max 1SQ V-Cam - Outdoor Flight
description:
A quick outdoor flight of the new Heli-Max 1SQ V-Cam quadcopter, using the new Tactic TTX650.  I show off how stable it is, do some flips and rolls, and some fast forward flight.

Enjoy!
-Ryan
